gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed advanced or metastatic solid tumor's (excluding central nervous system tumors other than IDHwt glioblastoma), with measurable disease as per RECIST 1.1 or RANO 2.0 criteria for participants with IDHwt glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a first-in-human Phase 1/2, multicenter, open-label study of S095035 as single-agent, or in combination with TNG462 in adult participants with advanced or metastatic solid tumors with homozygous deletion of MTAP

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: that have progressed after at least one prior treatment regimen given for advanced/metastatic disease, and for whom additional effective standard therapy is not available.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Change from baseline in plasma concentrations of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) and/or tumor symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA) residues during treatment: Phase 1 only

coder_notes: Basket trial of MTAP-deleted solid tumours; IDHwt glioblastoma explicitly eligible in inclusion criteria (no GBM-specific arm; GBM presumably enters Phase 1 or Phase 2 Arm 1d basket). S095035 role differs by arm: single agent in Arms 1/1a-1d (coded experimental_monotherapy) and experimental_combination with TNG462 in Arms 2/2a-2c. Regimen coded combination because combination arms exist; single-agent arms are monotherapy. IDH-wildtype requirement applies only to the CNS subgroup. CDKN2A homozygous deletion is mentioned only as a trigger for MTAP pre-screening in China (not an entry requirement), so not listed. PK is plasma only. Arm labels copied without trailing colons.
